bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM judges in pairwise comparisons by swapping the order of the two candidate outputs and measuring the averaged evaluation accuracy and self-agreement rate (using Krippendorff's alpha) across both directions.

Qualitative case study analysis of LLM generation error patterns to identify if the evaluator improperly favors outputs with structured presentations (e.g., numbered lists, professional layouts) or positive tones despite failing to properly execute the instruction.
